subject: MAP draft: SOC2 package delivery & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@zenatasystems.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@zenatasystems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft: SOC2 package delivery & next steps

Hi Elena / Raj —

Thanks for the call today. Per our discussion, I’m attaching a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a starter SOC 2 evidence checklist so we can align on responsibilities and target dates.

High-level MAP milestones (proposed):
- Security questionnaire submission (Zenata) — due: 2026-03-10 — owner: Zenata
- SOC 2 evidence delivery (Redwood) — due: 2026-03-20 — owner: Redwood (Vivek)
- Security review & clarifications (Zenata) — due: 2026-03-24 — owner: Zenata
- Final review meeting (joint) — target: 2026-03-18 (prep) / 2026-03-25 (final)
- Contract signatures & procurement close — target close date: 2026-04-15

Dependencies / notes:
- Zenata security team will review the submitted questionnaire and evidence; any gaps may add one week to the timeline.
- Redwood will provide an evidence bundle (control narratives, test evidence, configuration screenshots, log samples) and a SOC 2 summary.
- We can redact or summarize any proprietary screenshots if needed.

Attachments:
- MAP-draft-v1.pdf (outline milestones + owners)
- SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (evidence checklist & suggested artifacts)

Next steps: please confirm the owners/dates above and let us know who should be included from your security team for evidence review. If the dates look tight, let me know which milestones you’d prefer to shift.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@zenatasystems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@zenatasystems.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T17:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: SOC2 package delivery & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is a great start.

A couple quick asks/edits from our side:
- Can we move the SOC 2 evidence delivery date to 2026-03-24? Our security lead needs a week after questionnaire submission to reconcile internal artifacts.
- Please clarify which specific artifacts you expect for "log samples" (time-range, anonymization expected?).
- Who will be the point person on the Redwood side for uploads/consumption of evidence? Prefer a single contact.

Looping in Raj (security) for any technical clarifications: Raj — can you confirm the evidence format and whether you need raw logs or summarized extracts?

If we keep the final review meeting the week of 3/22 that works better than the earlier date.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director, IT Security | Zenata Systems
elena.morales@zenatasystems.com

Marissa —

Draft reply suggestions and ownership notes:
- We should confirm Redwood will own producing the control narratives, screenshots of config (IAM roles, VPC configs), sample logs (anonymized) and the SOC 2 summary report.
- Assign Vivek as Redwood security lead and primary uploader for the SOC2 bundle. Target delivery: 2026-03-20 (we can push to 3/23 if Zenata requests 3/24).
- Add KMS rotation and key management documentation to the evidence checklist (Zenata specifically asked about KMS earlier in discovery).

I'll vouch for providing redacted log snippets rather than full raw logs unless Zenata signs an NDA for raw artifacts.

If Vivek can reply to Elena with a short deliverables list + attachments, we should be set.

-r

- Control narratives (all in PDF) — due: 2026-03-20 (owner: Redwood/Security)
- Configuration screenshots (IAM, network, logging) — due: 2026-03-20

Attachments (stubbed):
- SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx (rows: artifact, owner, format, notes)

SGTM — looking forward to the deliverables.

Best,
Elena
